- He has been associated with The Brattle Group, a consulting firm, where he worked as a principal.
- He has written extensively on dynamic pricing of electricity, time-of-use rates, and customer response to price signals.
- He has published numerous articles, papers, and op-eds in trade publications and academic journals on energy policy.
- He earned his PhD in economics from the University of California, Davis.
